scope: Native macOS qualification only; full final-head CI is checked separately before PR ready

tests.name: recognizes only its owned process policy using the real Darwin ABI
kills detached/reparented actors and removes private temp after owner SIGKILL without touching an unrelated process
keeps workspace multilinks read-only and refuses multiply named secrets
resolves nested protected symlinks without following workspace symlinks
does not invent unsupported OS/architecture combinations
compiles the fixed SBPL on the real system
runs node, sh, git and descendants with private HOME and caches
runs installed npm, pip, cargo, rustc and go using private caches
does not grant write handles to the owner/guardian Node and CROT runtime
rejects protected reads/writes, outside writes and symlink escape
denies real control and direct Docker sockets, allows only the mediated socket
network=on permits host loopback; off refuses non-loopback
network=off permits host loopback; off refuses non-loopback
returns audited Docker 403 without reaching a daemon
mediates a positive Docker byte stream and refuses protected/writable host binds
does not modify an external file through a pre-existing workspace hardlink
refuses admission when a protected secret already has another name outside CROT
cannot turn a new external hardlink into an outside write
blocks security CLI access to CROT Keychain secrets
kills detached/reparented and ordinary descendants by immutable Seatbelt identity
blocks changing even the current UID/GID before an actor can hide ownership
lets the real command finish its graceful SIGTERM handler before draining
fails closed and drains existing actors if guardian acknowledgement hits a broken output pipe
never drains another admitted Core's actors
does not allow actors to replace or stack their inherited sandbox identity
remains fail-closed after close
canonicalizes existing aliases and absent leaves
escapes Scheme literals, rejects controls, never interpolates raw policy
denies by default, confines writes, keychain IPC and process-group escape
protects real service state/control and http-token, reports ready; full_control stays unrestricted
denies the security CLI access to an existing CROT Keychain item (not a missing-item test)
keeps local full_control unconfined even with the real registered macOS backend ready
keeps full_control unrestricted and refuses remote execution when L1 is absent
reuses only toolchain links and default selection, not host credentials or other settings
